_readme: Groups of keys that share ONE English value but are rightly translated
differently inside a locale, so that `scripts/i18n-parity.mjs` (and the vitest
gate `scripts/i18n-parity-gate.test.js`) can fail on every OTHER such group —
which is one concept drifting into two words, the defect behind TERM-001,
TERM-002 and TERM-004 of the 2026-09-19 i18n audit.
"*" covers every locale in which the group diverges. An entry whose group no
longer diverges is reported as stale, so this file cannot rot.
A reason names the two jobs the English word is doing: a verb vs an adjective,
gender / number agreement, a theme name vs a lightness range. "It reads better
here" is not a reason — if one English label truly needs two translations, the
cleaner fix is usually two English values.
Seeded 2026-09-20; every entry was read in context by a reviewer at native

All.fr: agreement with three head nouns: Tout (chip set), Toutes (catégories), Tous (préréglages)

Clear.*: verb 'clear the field' (common.clear) vs the Clear distinctness tier, an adjective

Compare.de: nav-chip noun Vergleich vs hand-off menu infinitive Vergleichen

Dark.*: theme / dye-palette label (ダーク, Sombre, 다크, 深色) vs the character creator's darker lip / face-paint half, Lobby row 2122 (濃い, Opaque, 짙게, 浓艳)

Light.*: the additive-light mixing model vs the Light theme name vs the character creator's lighter lip / face-paint half, Lobby row 2123 (薄い, Translucide, 옅게, 清淡)

Remove.ko: 삭제 deletes the uploaded preview image; 제거 removes an item from a list

Save.de: Speichern saves a form; Merken bookmarks a preset

Saved.fr: plural tab label Enregistrés vs singular button state Enregistré
